sections.title: The Routine Grind
sections.intent: Establish the baseline reality of the tutorial dungeon before the collapse.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen witnesses the first UI glitch during a standard mob pull.

sections.title: The Void Breach
sections.intent: Escalate the glitch into a full-scale environmental collapse.
sections.end_condition: The dungeon boss is consumed by purple static and transformed into a Void-horror.

sections.title: The Great Escape
sections.intent: Force a desperate flight from the crumbling instance.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen exits the dungeon portal just as the instance is flagged as 'Corrupted'.

sections.title: The Quiet After the Storm
sections.intent: Allow Kaelen to assess his survival and the state of his character.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen finds a secluded spot to open his broken character sheet.

sections.title: Decoding the Glitch
sections.intent: Introduce the mechanics of the Void-Touched class through experimentation.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen successfully triggers his first 'Void-Touched' passive skill.

sections.title: The First Exploit
sections.intent: Demonstrate the power of the new class by breaking a minor game rule.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen uses a glitch-jump to bypass a high-level locked gate.

sections.title: The Deletion Protocol
sections.intent: Establish the ticking clock as the System attempts to purge the zone.
sections.end_condition: A system-wide broadcast announces the immediate deletion of the starter zone.

sections.title: Through the Pixelated Woods
sections.intent: Navigate a landscape that is literally dissolving into code.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen reaches the shimmering instance barrier at the edge of the world.

sections.title: Breaking the Barrier
sections.intent: Use Void powers to force an exit into the persistent world.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen steps through the pixelated barrier into the open world of Oakhaven.

sections.title: The Road to Oakhaven
sections.intent: Show the scale of the Void-breach outside the tutorial zone.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen arrives at the city gates to find them under siege by 'null' entities.

sections.title: City of Chaos
sections.intent: Explore the social and physical breakdown within the hub city.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen secures a room in a tavern that is temporarily shielded from glitches.

sections.title: The Hunted
sections.intent: Introduce the System's automated enforcers as a primary antagonist.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen witnesses a 'glitched' player being dragged away by System Enforcers.

sections.title: Underworld Contacts
sections.intent: Navigate the city's criminal element to find a solution to Kaelen's instability.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen meets a rogue coder in the city's sewers who knows about stabilizers.

sections.title: The Stabilizer Heist
sections.intent: Infiltrate a high-security vault to steal a prototype item.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen retrieves the prototype stabilizer from the vault.

sections.title: Integration
sections.intent: Stabilize Kaelen's power and prepare for the next phase of growth.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen installs the stabilizer, successfully stopping his mana-implosion.

sections.title: The Crypt Entrance
sections.intent: Begin the first major dungeon crawl to retrieve a Void Shard.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen defeats the corrupted gatekeeper of the Sunken Crypt.

sections.title: Navigating the Glitch-Maze
sections.intent: Challenge Kaelen with environmental puzzles and evolved monsters.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen reaches the central chamber of the crypt.

sections.title: The Shard Guardian
sections.intent: A high-intensity boss fight for the first major power-up.
sections.end_condition: The Void Shard is absorbed into Kaelen's chest, triggering a global announcement.

sections.title: Data Extraction
sections.intent: Use the Shard to access hidden information about the world.
sections.end_condition: The first developer log begins to play within Kaelen's UI.

sections.title: The Truth Revealed
sections.intent: Deliver the core mystery revelation about the Void's origin.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen discovers the System was designed to fail by its own Architects.

sections.title: The Rebel's Path
sections.intent: Shift Kaelen's motivation from survival to active rebellion.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen decides to find an ally who knows the old world's code.

sections.title: Finding the Sentinel
sections.intent: Track down a potential ally in the wilderness.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen tracks Lyra to a hidden camp in the mountains.

sections.title: The Purge Squad Attack
sections.intent: Force Kaelen and Lyra to work together against a common enemy.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen and Lyra defeat the System 'Purge' squad together.

sections.title: The Pact
sections.intent: Solidify the alliance and set the next objective.
sections.end_condition: Lyra shakes Kaelen's hand, agreeing to lead him to the Rift Core.

sections.title: The Storm Approaches
sections.intent: Build tension as the first true Void-storm hits the city.
sections.end_condition: The first purple lightning strike hits the city walls of Oakhaven.

sections.title: Holding the Line
sections.intent: A massive battle to protect the city from being overwritten.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen uses a massive Void-AoE to clear the main gate of 'null' entities.

sections.title: The Aftermath
sections.intent: Show the cost of the defense and the System's escalation.
sections.end_condition: The surge recedes, leaving Kaelen marked for immediate 'Hard Deletion'.

sections.title: The Inquisitor's Arrival
sections.intent: Introduce the ultimate System enforcer.
sections.end_condition: The Level 99 Inquisitor corners Kaelen in the city ruins.

sections.title: The Exploit Battle
sections.intent: A tactical fight where Kaelen must use his glitches to survive.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen finds the 'Admin' vulnerability in the Inquisitor's code.

sections.title: Gaining Access
sections.intent: Kaelen turns the tables on the System.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen absorbs the Inquisitor's administrative privileges.

sections.title: The Final Ascent
sections.intent: The final push toward the center of the world's code.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen and Lyra reach the entrance to the Rift Core.

sections.title: The Core Guardians
sections.intent: Defeat the last line of System defenses.
sections.end_condition: The last System defense mechanism is shattered.

sections.title: The Choice
sections.intent: The ultimate decision on the fate of the world.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen shatters the final System constraint, fully awakening the Void.

sections.title: The New World Order
sections.intent: Show the immediate consequences of the System's collapse.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen surveys the transformed, lawless landscape.

sections.title: Setting Up Base
sections.intent: Establish a new status quo for the survivors.
sections.end_condition: The first 'Void-Base' is established in the ruins of the old world.

sections.title: The Next Quest
sections.intent: Hook the reader for the next book in the series.
sections.end_condition: Kaelen accepts the new quest: 'Rebuild Reality'.
